what_it_does: Proposes an automated workflow to measure and analyze errors that occur when graphics processor (GPU) kernel code runs in different floating-point numeric formats (such as 16-bit or reduced-precision variants). The workflow records GPU kernel execution and replays it on a computer processor (CPU) for detailed analysis using tools designed to detect numeric errors. It supports multiple precision modes including IEEE-compliant and reduced-precision formats, and measures the impact of compiler optimizations like -ffast-math on numeric accuracy.
